title: I Added 1 Dragon Each Game Until I LOSE (feat. jacksark)
summary: Reverse of the usual dragon-odds format: chess YouTuber jacksark (Jack Sarkisian) has only a king plus N Dragons (bishop + knight) while Tony has the full normal army; one dragon is added each game until Tony loses. Tony wins with 1 dragon (pawn promotion + ladder mate ~2:00) and keeps winning as dragons are added, finally losing to six dragons (~30:10).
rules: Opponent side: king + N Dragons (N = game number, starting at 1). Player side: full standard army.
After each player WIN add one dragon to the opponent; the run ends when the player loses (lost at 6).
Normal chess otherwise; online games with a clock.
win_condition: Survive as long as possible: checkmate the dragon side each game; the challenge ends on the first loss (video: lost at 6 dragons).
player_side: white (inferred; frames ambiguous — dragons shown black in hq3)

board.theme_notes: brown/tan lichess-style board with webcam overlay; dragon icons (black dragons on board, one red-background dragon icon)

setup: Player: standard army. Opponent: king on e8 + N dragons on its back rank (positions visual-only).
events: +1 opponent dragon after each player win until the player loses
current_impl_issues: Impl 'kingplus' gives the PLAYER the king + dragons; in this video the player has the full army and the OPPONENT gets king + dragons, increasing after each player win.
Impl increments after losses; video increments after wins.
